name: erp-system

scripts.build: cd frontend_src && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:manual

//build-order: The manual lands in static/manual/, and Vite empties static/ on every build — so build:manual must run AFTER build, never before. build:all does both in the right order; the Dockerfile keeps them in separate stages and copies the manual in last. Running build alone is fine: with no manual present the app 404s /manual/ and Settings simply omits the button.
//build-manual-deps: build:manual needs the pins in docs/manual/requirements.txt: pip install -r docs/manual/requirements.txt
